changelog:
What's new in v5.0.10:
- Material themes, custom icons and Force Select improvements.
- WhatsApp browser recovery and single-window improvements.
- Session persistence and PDF preview performance improvements.
- Corrected animated installer: offers interactive removal of older NSIS/MSI installations instead of blocking setup. Choose No if the old uninstaller asks to remove license data.
Real-machine legacy migration acceptance remains pending. Later accent-switcher, dark-palette and standalone-session fixes are source-only and are not included in this installer.
